name: Shunya
storyline:
A classified medical facility conducted secret human experiments in pursuit of creating the perfect superhuman. But when the test subjects began retaining the memories of previous patients, the project spiraled out of control. Every failed experiment was erased from the records—along with anyone who knew the truth.

You awaken as Patient #17, one of the few surviving test subjects, with only fragments of your memories intact. As you explore the abandoned facility, you'll uncover disturbing patient files, forgotten research, and the horrifying fate of those who came before you. But you're not alone. The Janitor still roams the halls, carrying out the facility's final order: eliminate every remaining experiment.

To survive, you'll have to uncover the truth behind the project before you become the next name added to the list of terminated patients.
summary:
Shunya is a survival horror game where you must escape a secret medical facility while uncovering the horrifying truth behind its human experiments. Trapped as Patient #17, you awaken with fragmented memories, pursued by the mysterious Janitor whose sole purpose is to erase every failed subject before they escape.

Search abandoned wards, laboratories, and restricted treatment rooms for key items needed to unlock your path forward while avoiding the Janitor's relentless patrols. Stay out of sight, listen carefully, and use the environment to survive as every patient file and hidden note reveals another piece of the facility's disturbing history.

Explore a claustrophobic research facility inspired by secret medical experiments, filled with abandoned equipment, unsettling patient records, and atmospheric environments designed to keep you constantly on edge. Every corridor hides a new danger, every room tells a forgotten story, and every discovery brings you closer to the truth.

Will you escape the facility... or become another terminated patient?
